name: print-social-photo-overlay-cover-with-thin-grotesque
title: Darkened photo cover with huge light caps and a side caption
whatItIs: A 4:5 post with a darkened photo of two women running through a meadow. A giant white light-weight two-line headline sits at the top with a narrow caption to its right marked by an asterisk, a small wordmark at the bottom and an arrow glyph in the corner.
whatItMeans: Open, hopeful and calm; the running figures bring movement and the thin type feels premium.
techniques: Darken a natural photo so white type reads.
Set a huge light-weight headline and a slim side caption.
Use an asterisk as a bullet for the caption.
Place a small logo at the bottom centre and a directional glyph at the corner.

vocabulary.definition: A dark tint over a photo for text legibility.
Uppercase type in a light weight.
A narrow column of text beside a headline.
An arrow mark suggesting the next slide.
